claims.content: The Customer enters a search term into the 'Search' box and clicks 'Go'.
If no results are found, the system displays a message stating 'No results found for your search.' and suggests browsing categories or using different keywords.
The Customer can click on a category link from the homepage or navigation menu instead of using the search bar.
If the selected category has sub-categories, the system displays a list of sub-categories for the Customer to choose from.
The Customer uses the 'Sort By' dropdown on a product listing page to change the order of items (e.g., Price: Low to High, Newest First).
The Customer applies one or more filters (e.g., Brand, Metal Type, Stone Type) from the left-hand sidebar to narrow down the product results.
The Customer clicks the 'Clear All' link next to the 'Filter By' heading to remove all applied filters and return to the unfiltered product list.
